Test plugin with documented third-party services.

== Description ==

This plugin uses Stripe as a third-party service for payment processing.

When a user makes a payment, data is sent to Stripe's secure servers for processing.

For more information about Stripe:
- Service: https://stripe.com
- Privacy Policy: https://stripe.com/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://stripe.com/terms

== Installation ==

1. Upload the plugin files to the `/wp-content/plugins/test-plugin` directory.
2. Activate the plugin through the 'Plugins' screen in WordPress.
